children: EUROPE LEADS GLOBAL POSITIONING RACE, SAYS CITI
Europe remains the standout region for equity positioning, according to Citi's latest weekly flow analysis, with investors adding new money rather than simply unwinding bearish bets.
The US bank says the key global theme is the gap between markets attracting new risk-taking and those rallying mainly because investors are closing short positions.
Europe sits firmly in the first camp. Euro STOXX 50
attracted $4.9 billion of new risk flows last week with no short covering, while the DAX
also saw a combination of fresh longs and short unwinds.
"Europe remains the strongest source of positive positioning momentum globally," writes Citi quant analyst David Chew.
That contrasts with the United States, where headline positioning improved but conviction remains less convincing.
Much of last week's recovery was driven by short covering rather than new long buying, suggesting investors are becoming less bearish rather than more bullish.
